title.narrative: HCFC phase-out management plan (stage II) (air-conditioning sector)

description.narrative: Stage II of the HPMP was approved at the 79th meeting of the Executive Committee for the period from 2017 to 2025 to reduce HCFC consumption by 67.5 per cent of its baseline, in the amount of US $11,786,341 consisting of US $5,996,841, plus agency support costs of US $419,779 for UNIDO, US $3,695,722, plus agency support costs of US $258,701 for UNDP, US $1,055,000, plus agency support costs of US $126,050 for UNEP, and US $207,300, plus agency support costs of US $26,949 for the Government of Germany. The objective of the component of air conditioning sector is to provide commercial beneficiary companies with technical assistance to phase out its use of HCFC-22. The companies manufacture central air conditioning equipment for light commercial and residential use. The technical assistance includes redesigning and building prototypes with low GWP refrigerants, testing and evaluating the prototypes through field testing, and providing financial and market feasibility assessment. It also examines the introduction of indirect evaporative cooling (IEC) in the commercial air-conditioning applications.
